matchingRule: masterplan v4 §16.4: concept + non-dimensional context period + unit + scaled value must equal a VISIBLE inline-XBRL fact in the filing

unanswerableRules.OTHER_COMPANY: for each corpus A and each other filer B, the first 10 of B's numeric questions (hash order), asked of A
unanswerableRules.OTHER_YEAR: for each corpus A, the first 10 of A's numeric questions asked of fiscal year Y = (earliest year any non-dimensional context in A's corpus touches) - 5, using A's real fiscal-year period from companyfacts (the annual 10-K duration whose end is nearest the source month/day in Y, within 10 days)
unanswerableRules.limitation: Absence is established against tagged XBRL contexts only. Untagged prose or tables could still state an OTHER_YEAR figure; a person spot-checks a sample before the set is treated as frozen (PREREG openItems).
